title: quest smp plgin
description: quests, custom items, shops and more
body:
quest smp is a unique smp
as you can imagen from the title this server has 40+ quests that you can complete 4 a day theres hard quests and easy quest the harder the quests the more coins you get








what can you do with coins?
type /shop and there we have 25+ custom items that you can buy using the coins
or do /rshop








commands:
/quests
/shop
/rshop

admin commands
/ci shows a gui that lets admin get every custom item
/money <add/remove/set> <player> <amount>
/resetquest <player> resets a spesific players quest
